notes.title: Update Notes for 6/26/2024
notes.content:
Hello ya'll, Happy Summer Sale!

[list]
[*] Fix a bug on some storefronts where special events on Steam would erroneously be displayed.
[*] Fix a bug where the app won't close as expected in all cases.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 6/18/2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Per user request, Crosshair V2 no longer requires an installation of the .NET 8.0 Framework. All required files are now included.
[*] Fix an edge case bug wherein the app would not close as expected due to a lingering prompt. The prompt will now be brought to the front of the screen during the app exit procedure.
[/list]

notes.title: October Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We noticed some reviews about the app crashing so we're trying to fix those bugs. We just pushed an update and are troubleshooting any bugs that come up. If you see an influx of updates it's because we're fixing bugs, updating the app, and repeating the process.

Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Monitor selection, positioning controls, and auto-launch on startup!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

When we said we want everyone to enjoy a custom crosshair for free, we really meant it. That involves making sure every PC can use it with ease.

Thats why we added these features in the Settings menu (F4):
- Monitor Selection
- Position Offset with arrow keys
- Auto run the app on Startup

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43505235/b35f2980217cd6b7d9fe12e75bc82b8fb74b781a.gif[/img]

Enjoy!
